items.title: Harold Mabern interviewed by Monk Rowe, Clinton, New York, March 31, 2010

ctx.x: But anyway that’s the way it was. But I have great respect for all the people involved with it because all the people, all races, gave up a lot to make things better. That’s why when I look at some of these young people out here acting like fools and dressing like clowns it bothers me that everything — here you’ve got a black president of the United States and you would think you would be so motivated but they’re not. It’s like they go on worse. You know it makes no sense. There’s been a lot of people to give up…
to play jazz and a lot of them don’t even take advantage of that. It makes no sense you see what I’m saying. Oh Rosa Parks.
